recent_posts: The real trades at 5.207 per dollar, down 1.9% over the week and 1.8% over 30 days. Even so, it has gained 5.9% for the year. #Brazil $BRL
The naira trades at 1,352 to the dollar, its strongest level in 90 days. It has gained 1.4% over that span and is now 12.1% above its weakest point of the past year. #Nigeria $NGN

The krona stands at 122.8 against the dollar, virtually unchanged over the past week. It has strengthened 2.1% over the past 30 days and is 2.1% stronger than at the start of the year, despite moving only 0.23% on average per day. #Iceland $ISK
The Dominican peso fell 0.65% against the dollar, its largest daily move in 32 days, and closed at 58.7, its weakest level in 30 days. It has depreciated 7.31% year to date. #DominicanRepublic $DOP
